verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a resource-oriented REST API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference and claims it can reach any existing object in the account. Its MCP server also exposes access to and management of controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more. However, nothing explicitly states UI/API parity, and evidence does not show that UI workflows such as Trust Center customization, access-review decisions, policy editing and request approvals are API-operable. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity commitment, documented API coverage of write and workflow actions across all UI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use Secureframe's API to connect to any existing object in your Secureframe account.
Secureframe exposes a REST API for use by customers, partners, and community developers.
The Secureframe MCP server allows you to access and manage your Secureframe data — controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks, and more — as Model Context Protocol tools.
Connect an AI assistant to your Secureframe workspace and query or update your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
